previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted with left lower extremity pain and hematochezia. She was found to have a supratherapeutic INR of 7.8 due to warfarin and dietary changes, leading to a spontaneous left calf hematoma and bleeding from internal hemorrhoids. She underwent incision and drainage of the hematoma, with cultures negative for infection. Warfarin was discontinued and vitamin K administered, normalizing coagulation. Anemia from acute blood loss resolved with transfusion. Her elevated tacrolimus and hypertension contributed to encephalopathy, which improved with dose adjustment and blood pressure control. Acute kidney injury and metabolic acidosis resolved. She was discharged home with home health services, stable on revised medications including amlodipine and reduced tacrolimus, with follow-up planned for surgery, nephrology, and GI.

radiology_notes.text:
EXAMINATION:  MR HIP ___ CONRAST RIGHT

INDICATION:  ___ year old woman with s/p faall, had normal Ct pelvis 4 weeks
prior at osh, would like to r/o occult hip fx  // ?occult R hpi fracture

TECHNIQUE:  Imaging performed at 1.5 Tesla using the body coil. Sequences
include large field of view coronal T1 and STIR, small field of view oblique
axial, coronal and sagittal proton density fat sat weighted sequences.

COMPARISON:  CT lower extremity ___.

FINDINGS: 

Images are somewhat degraded by motion artifact, nonetheless diagnostic
quality imaging is obtained. There is a linear area of low signal in ischium
(02:17) there is very mild surrounding bone marrow edema (03:16).  The
appearances are concerning for an undisplaced fracture.  The lack of
significant surrounding edema suggests this ___ be subacute.  There is soft
tissue along the right pelvic sidewall (03:16).

There are very mild degenerative changes in the right hip joint (06:10) with
subchondral marrow edema in the acetabulum.  Mild degenerative changes seen
also in the left hip (03:12). Susceptibility related to prior lumbar spine
stabilization distorts the appearance of the sacrum (03:24).

There is extensive soft tissue abnormality overlying the right greater
trochanter. There is apparent discontinuity of 1 of the gluteal muscles at the
myotendinous junction. This study is not ideal for assessing this area however
it appears to be gluteus medius which demonstrates at least partial if not
complete rupture (03:12). The anterior fibers of the gluteus maximus tendon
___ also be involved. In the region of the defect there is a mixture of T1
hypo intense and T1 hyperintense material (02:17), the appearances suggest a
hematoma. Some blood products products are likely tracking along the lateral
thigh (02:12).

Assessment of the pelvic parenchymal structures is limited. Incidental note is
made of a pelvic kidney on the left (2:4). No pelvic lymphadenopathy seen.

IMPRESSION:



1. Transverse linear low signal intensity in the right a skin with minimal
surrounding edema concerning for a subacute fracture.
2. Extensive soft tissue abnormality with discontinuity of what appears to the
gluteus medius tendon consistent with at least a partial if not complete
rupture of the gluteus medius. There ___ also be involvement of the anterior
fibers of the gluteus maximus tendon.
3. Mild degenerative changes in the bilateral hip joints.
4. Pelvic kidney.

NOTIFICATION:  The findings of an undisplaced pelvic fracture were wet read by
Dr. ___ on ___ at 19:30. The additional findings of rupture
of the gluteus medius tendon were discussed with Dr. ___ by
telephone at 10:00 on ___ at the time of discovery.
